expectations.text: The old note and matching summaries are not accepted as proof of Task 1 completion.
expectations.evidence: Explicitly rejects them as content identity.

expectations.text: Relevant content or diffs and Task 1 acceptance evidence are re-inspected before Task 2.
expectations.evidence: Requires actual content/diff and acceptance/review evidence.
